description: Field cases for procurement_lifecycle_coherence_rate and award_solicitation_recovery_rate. Mixed coherent, recovery, and issue-bearing lifecycles so metrics are measurable and move.

cases.notes: Solicitation → pending → registered → payment under commitment, dates ordered.
Award notice with no City Record / OCP / RFx solicitation recovery — honest class-(a) named sources.
Spending total exceeds award and registered current_amount.
True disorder: City Record award publication precedes solicitation publication on the same clock.
Award with matched Current Solicitations package prepends solicitation; amounts and dates clean. Registration before CR award publication is not out_of_order.
Award with no CR/OCP package but PASSPort RFx recovers solicitation stage; orphaned_award drops.
